review.label: NON_EQUIVALENT
review.rationale: The mutation replaces a conditional check `if manifest_fingerprint != manifest.manifest_digest:` with `if False:`, which unconditionally disables the branch body. The original condition evaluates whether a manifest fingerprint matches a digest, and when they differ, executes some behavior (e.g., raising an error, logging, rejecting the request, or taking a corrective action). By substituting `if False:`, that branch body becomes permanently unreachable, meaning any observable behavior that previously occurred when the fingerprints did not match will no longer occur. This produces a clear, observable behavioral difference whenever `manifest_fingerprint != manifest.manifest_digest` would have been true in the original code.
